note: Hand-checked candidates for a backlink. Set status to asked, listed or declined; listed also follows from Bing by itself.

prospects.why: City of Oldenburg integration page with a curated list of 14 online German-learning offers (Ankommen-App, vhs-Lernportal, DW, Goethe, Sprachnudel, besser-deutsch.com, buchstaben.com). It already lists a third-party app, langula.app, for its free placement test and Einbürgerungstest trainer, so a free exam-practice site fits its pattern. Last changed 5 Nov 2026, so it is actively maintained.
prospects.how: Email the named contact Dorothea Jäger (deutschlernen[at]stadt-oldenburg.de, shown on the page). Offer two free, no-account entries: the 5-minute DTZ tasters at /gratis-test and the Einbürgerungstest trainer with all 310 BAMF questions at /einbuergerungstest. Mention the Ukrainian and Russian versions (/uk, /ru). Be upfront that full Modelltests are paid, and ask only for the free pages to be listed.

prospects.why: Deutscher Bildungsserver (DIPF) page 'Online-Portale zum Deutsch lernen' in its adult-education section. It lists 8 portals, including commercial ones such as Klett Online-Übungen, learn-german-online.net and the deutsch-lernen-online.net Wegweiser. It was updated 18 Jun 2026 and is a high-trust .de education domain. A related page, 'Deutschunterricht und Sprachförderung für Flüchtlinge' (seite=11454, updated 16 Feb 2026), is a second slot on the same domain.
prospects.how: Use the site's 'Link vorschlagen' form (/eintragen.html). Submit the free DTZ taster hub /gratis-test as a portal for exam practice at A2–B1 (no account needed), with a neutral description that names the provider and is not affiliated with BAMF, telc or g.a.s.t. Submit the Einbürgerungstest trainer separately if they accept a second entry.

prospects.why: Caritas guide 'Kostenlose Online-Hilfen für Flüchtlinge' by Matthias Colloseus, updated 23 Sep 2026. It lists handbookgermany, Ankommen, Integreat and Goethe tools, but has no exam-preparation entry yet, which is the gap we fill. The page explicitly invites suggestions via web@caritas.de. Very high trust domain.
prospects.how: Email web@caritas.de and propose a new 'Prüfung vorbereiten' line. Offer the free Einbürgerungstest trainer (/einbuergerungstest, all 310 questions, free, no account) and the free DTZ tasters (/gratis-test), with Ukrainian and Russian versions. Since the list is for free offers, pitch only the free pages and say plainly that full mock exams cost money.

prospects.why: City of Dresden 'Online Deutsch lernen' page under migration/Orientierungshilfen, section 'Kostenlose Online-Lernangebote'. It links about 20 external offers, including private sites such as deutschtraining.org, ein-tag-deutsch.de, slowgerman.com and languageguide.org, plus Goethe, DW, serlo ABC and vhs-Lernportal. There is no exam-practice entry yet. The page loaded (HTTP 200 via curl) after WebFetch returned 503.
prospects.how: Contact Dresden's Integrations- und Ausländerbeauftragte office through the contact link on dresden.de (the page shows no direct email). Offer the free DTZ tasters and the free Einbürgerungstest trainer as the first entries for exam practice, and mention the /uk and /ru versions for the city's Ukrainian community.

prospects.why: Marburg Sprachenzentrum (Selbstlernzentrum) list of German-learning links with about 80 entries. It includes commercial platforms such as Lingoda, Babbel, Talkpal, DeutschAkademie and deutsch-uni.com, and has a 'Sprachtests und Prüfungen' section that today covers only Goethe, telc, TestDaF, DSH and placement tests. There is no DTZ or Einbürgerung entry, so our pages fill a clear gap.
prospects.how: Email the Sprachenzentrum (sz@staff.uni-marburg.de). Propose adding the free DTZ tasters (/gratis-test) under 'Prüfungen und Prüfungsvorbereitung' and the free Einbürgerungstest trainer. Keep the pitch short and factual: built on the published DTZ format, with no claim to be official.

prospects.why: 'Deutsch Lernen Online – Wegweiser' is a large directory of free German-learning offers, marked 'Zuletzt geprüft: November 2026'. It is linked from bildungsserver.de and uni-marburg.de, so it is trusted in this niche. Its Einstufungstests page lists 10 free tests, including ones from commercial providers (Sprachcaffe, ITT Leipzig, sprachtest.de). It has no exam-prep or DTZ category. The site carries marked ads ('Anzeige') and a partner page, so avoid anything that looks like a paid link.
prospects.how: Use the contact form at /kontakt. Suggest the free 5-minute DTZ tasters, which give an indicative A2/B1 band, for the Einstufungstests page, and the Einbürgerungstest trainer for Landeskunde. Ask for an editorial listing only. Decline if they ask for payment.

prospects.why: Duisburg's 'Wir sind Du' integration microsite. It links a PDF of German offers (dated 12.02.2025) and a Padlet, 'Lernmaterial Online – DaZ' (padlet.com/mfleuren/...), run by the Kommunales Integrationszentrum. The Padlet explicitly covers both 'kostenfreie und kostenpflichtige Angebote', so a commercial exam-prep site with free tasters is in scope. It was created in 2022 and modified 11 Nov 2026, so it is actively maintained. Note: a link on padlet.com carries less weight than one on duisburg.de.
prospects.how: Contact the Kommunales Integrationszentrum Duisburg through duisburg.de, or the Padlet owner through the Padlet. Offer the free DTZ tasters, the Einbürgerungstest trainer and the paid Teil-Pass for full Modelltests. Ask whether the PDF can also be updated at its next revision.

prospects.why: TU Braunschweig 'Useful Links for Learning German' self-learning page with 15 external sites, including commercial ones (Lingudora, Babbel, Pons, Langenscheidt, deutsch-perfekt.com) and several resources for Ukrainians. It has no exam section and no date. The audience is mostly students and refugees, so it fits less closely than the city pages, but the domain is strong.
prospects.how: Use the Contact page linked from the page (no named person shown). Propose the free DTZ tasters and the Einbürgerungstest trainer, highlighting the Ukrainian (/uk) version since the page already serves Ukrainian learners.

prospects.why: IHK Ulm Welcome Center page 'Kostenlose Sprachlernangebote' for internationals in vocational training. It lists about 11 offers (vhs-Lernportal, DW, Goethe 'Mein Weg nach Deutschland', Lunes, integrationskurs.net) and states B1 as the target level for apprenticeship entry. It has no exam-practice entry and no date. Trusted chamber domain.
prospects.how: Email Welcomecenter@ulm.ihk.de. Offer the free DTZ tasters as a quick way to check the B1 level, and the Einbürgerungstest trainer for long-term residents.

prospects.why: Bremen state service page 'Ukraine – Angebote zum Deutsch Lernen' (updated 04.11.2025). It lists courses, migration counselling and a small online section (Goethe online courses, buchstaben.com, Sprachcafés). The online part is thin and the page is mostly about courses. It is relevant because of the Ukrainian audience and the /uk mirror, but a listing is less likely than on the dedicated link lists.
prospects.how: Email the responsible office (office@soziales.bremen.de, Senatorin für Arbeit, Soziales, Jugend und Integration). Propose the Ukrainian version of the free tasters and the Einbürgerungstest trainer (/uk/...) under the online offers.

prospects.why: AlternativeTo listing for a freemium Einbürgerungstest app ('Einbürgerungstest 2026 Pro'), with an alternatives list and user-contributed entries. Users can add apps and web apps and mark them as alternatives. It is a low-weight link (likely nofollow), but it reaches people actively comparing Einbürgerungstest tools, and it is free and self-serve.
prospects.how: Create a software entry for the free web-based Einbürgerungstest trainer (/einbuergerungstest), category language learning / citizenship test, platform Web. Then suggest it as an alternative on this page. Describe it factually (310 BAMF questions, free, no account) and do not post reviews of our own product.
